scope: Read-only pure-source chart-authority review; no actualhorse field evaluation/export/capture/SAT/browser
question: Must nonplanar wet lining remain a physical YZ graph?
answer: No. A valid embedded3D strip may fold under a fixed planar projection. Failure of projected injectivity alone does not establish a3D intersection.
allowed_revision: New preserved source revision may use exact source-edge-phase/radial-layer intrinsic charts for deterministic tessellation, ownership, seam orientation and annular topology. This is not proof of chart-to-XYZ injectivity.
required_guards: Explicit eight-sheet source breakpoint inventory, exactlyperiodic phase seams, no missing/repeated knots or inconsistent seam aliases
Retained outer/inner directed loops and each shared-edge two-opposite incidence, complete global head disk topology, not only independent rectangular sheets
Actual serialized XYZ finite/nondegenerate geometry and raw retainedP/JW/protected normals/material/owner readback
Unchanged COMPLETE actualXYZ newmouth self/vsALL, fullhead/neck/mane and36gear/bit volume; newlining-vs-retainedcavity and newskin must remain included
Existing whole-edge/source-point certificates required for physical adjacency; intrinsic UV adjacency alone must never excuse a crossing
limits: Intrinsic UV success does not imply geometric embedding, outward anatomical placement, clearance, comfort or source-attested shape
Actual geometry may fail strictXYZ checks; preserve firstfailure rather than retune thresholds
Earlier physical-projection failure remains immutable; not relabeled a passing geometry result
recommendation: No conceptual blocker to the explicitly limited intrinsic-chart replacement. Review concrete new executable source and fixed recipe before actual candidate generation.
